# Office of Undergraduate Research

> The Office of Undergraduate Research at the University of Utah supports students in discovering, pursuing, and funding meaningful research experiences through mentorship, resources, and community partnerships.

OUR provides comprehensive support for undergraduate researchers including research opportunity matching, mentoring, funding programs like UROP and SPUR, ethics guidance through IRB Lab, and recognition through the annual Undergraduate Research Symposium. The office serves as a central hub connecting students with faculty mentors, research opportunities, and the resources needed to succeed in academic research.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Research
- Research Opportunities
- Research Funding
- Faculty Mentors
- Research Advising

## Getting Started with Research

- [Getting Started – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/researchadvising/getting-started): Four-step guide to beginning undergraduate research at University of Utah
- [How To Find A Mentor – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/researchadvising/how-to-find-a-mentor): Guide to finding faculty mentors and connecting with research partners
- [OUR Research Opportunity Database – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/find-a-research-opportunity): Searchable database of paid and volunteer research opportunities
- [Research Advising – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/researchadvising): Multi-level mentoring model and research advising support services

## Research Funding & Scholarships

- [Funding Fridays – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/funding-fridays): Weekly drop-in support for research funding and mentoring
- [Current Scholar Resources – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/research-scholarship-opportunities/current-scholar-resources): Resources for funded scholars including deadlines and requirements
- [Resources – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/researchadvising/resources): Comprehensive student resources including mentor database and funding

## Research Ethics & Compliance

- [IRB Lab – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/irb-lab): IRB approval process guidance and human subjects research ethics
- [Community Engaged Research – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/community-engaged-research): Community-based research methodology and partnership guidelines

## Faculty Mentorship & Partnerships

- [Faculty Affiliates – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/faculty-affiliates): Faculty affiliates program and mentor eligibility requirements
- [Faculty & Research Mentor Resources – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/faculty-campus-partnerships/faculty-research-mentor-resources): Resources for faculty mentors including funding and mentor certification
- [OUR Program Partners – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/faculty-campus-partnerships/our-program-partners): Partner research teams and campus collaborations for undergraduate research

## Student Achievements & Recognition

- [Student Accomplishments – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/awards-recognition/student-accomplishments): Outstanding research awards, prizes, and student recognition programs
- [OUR Success – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/about-us/our-success): Annual report showcasing OUR success metrics and student achievements

## About the Office

- [About Us – Office of Undergraduate Research](https://our.utah.edu/about-us): Mission, staff directory, and contact information for OUR
